title: National Cyber Crime Helpline 1930
department: State Cyber Police MP / Ministry of Home Affairs
eligibility: Victims of online financial fraud or cybercrime in MP
benefits: Immediate lien/freezing of defrauded money in culprit bank accounts if reported promptly
Direct routing to state cyber crime investigation teams
application_process: Step 1: Call 1930 within the 'golden hour' of fraud
Step 2: Share transaction reference numbers with helpline officer
Step 3: Complete formal acknowledgement ticket on cybercrime.gov.in
